block_readings.visual_reading: Six exact centres on the upper-right reef margin remain reef/exposure questions. Point8898 is visibly just seaward in dark water; the six more southern centres lie in dark continuous wave-textured water. Long dark curved surface streaks cross the image without breaking the marine context.

Four western centres8863/8866/8869/8873 cross the coloured shallow reef rim. All63 other centres lie seaward in visible dark water; nearby cloud/shadow features are away from their exact placements. Dark surface streaks are not treated as automatic cloud shadow or land.
All15 centres at the eastern side lie in continuous dark sea. Scattered clouds occur well west of the centres; water texture continues through the marked context.
All61 centres lie in dark continuous marine water, with broad wave/surface streaks. A small bright cloud lies east of the central group and avoids the marked centres.
